rachael: Quick heads-up — scheduling a pen-test dry-run in staging next Thu 2026-10-12 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need ephemeral RBAC, KMS key window, and audit-log snapshots. Can we lock windows and owners?

samir: +1. Clarify KMS approach: do we rotate the key or create a grant scoped to assessor role? aim for least-privilege. :thinking_face:

ada (infra): We should use a short-lived grant instead of rotating; rotation touches all services. I can script a grant + assume-role combo. Example we use:
```
ARN_ROLE=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-temp
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-llm --grantee-principal $ARN_ROLE --operations Encrypt Decrypt --constraints EncryptedKeyList=[]
# then assume role for assessor to use grant id in session
```
I'll also upload grant metadata to the staging run folder.

matt (oncall): Window works for me but need SIEM snapshots and retention check before we open access. Make sure audit log TTL covers 90d for the evidence. I'll be primary oncall for the window. :white_check_mark:

linda (sec-eng): Also request enabling object-level audit for the model artifacts bucket and forward to Splunk/secure-logging before test. We need log evidence for any simulated exfil attempts. Who's taking Splunk forwarder config?

ada (infra): I'll take Splunk forwarder in staging. Plan: snapshot CloudTrail + S3 access logs and forward. Upload path: s3://redwood-pt-logs/staging/1766668888/

ops-bot: CI job started: RUN-PT-KEYDROP #1234 — https://ci.redwood.dev/job/RUN-PT-KEYDROP/1234 :gear:

rachael: OK assigning tasks — @ada (infra) create ephemeral IAM role + KMS grant and run log snapshot upload, include grant-id in RUN-PT-KEYDROP artifacts. @linda verify Splunk forwarding and retention; post confirmation here. @samir own vuln triage plan + checklist for retest acceptance criteria. I'll open a tracking ticket RUN-PT-245 and put owners + SLOs. :clipboard:

samir: Added preliminary checklist to RUN-PT-245:
- access window recorded (start/end)
- KMS grant id + TTL
- role ARN used for assessor
- pre-test smoke run hitting model endpoints (10 requests/min x 5 paths)
- cache flush before test
- evidence upload location confirmed

matt (oncall): Note: flush KV/prefix cache before run. Endpoint to call: `POST https://staging.api.redwood.internal/internal/clear-cache` with header `x-internal-secret`. Make sure ops has a runbook entry.

rachael: Good call. Add to RUN-PT-245: runbook step to call clear-cache and verify 0 active sessions.

ada (infra): I will push a small helper to the run artifacts:
```bash
# helper to make grant + upload logs
./scripts/pt-prep --env staging --grant-duration 3600 --upload-path s3://redwood-pt-logs/staging/1766668888/
```
I'll post the artifact link when done.

linda (sec-eng): Quick question on audit snapshots: what retention tag do we apply to the evidence bucket? We usually set `redwood:evidence=true` and lifecycle to 365d for PT evidence. OK to follow that?

rachael: 365d is fine for now. Add data classification and contact for e-discovery in ticket.

samir: For retest acceptance: must pass smoke + no high/critical regressions from baseline evals. We'll mark retest slot only after remediation PRs have automated tests passing.

matt (oncall): I'll be available during the window. Pager rota: matt -> devon -> ana. Posting oncall contact in RUN-PT-245.

rachael: Perfect. Next actions:
- ada: post grant-id + artifact link by EOD Tue.
- linda: confirm Splunk forwarder + retention flag by Wed.
- samir: finalize checklist & baseline evals.
- matt: add clear-cache run to runbook.
I'll ping again 24h before the window. :pray:

ops-bot: RUN-PT-KEYDROP artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/RUN-PT-KEYDROP/1234/artifacts/ - awaiting ada upload.

ada (infra): Uploaded grant metadata and a short log snapshot to s3://redwood-pt-logs/staging/1766668888/objects.json. Grant-id: 8a6c-... will expire in 3600s. Posting link in ticket RUN-PT-245.

linda (sec-eng): Verified Splunk forwarder config in staging and retention tag applied (`redwood:evidence=true`). Confirmed object-level auditing enabled. :thumbsup:

samir: Checklist finalized and attached to RUN-PT-245. Added smoke tests and regression gating. Good to proceed.

rachael: Thanks team — closing prep loop. I'll create a short pre-window slack reminder 24h prior. :bell:

matt (oncall): thumbs up.
